name: sound-clean
title: Sound cleaner
description: Takes steady noise (a hum, a fan, hiss) out of a sound and hands the cleaned sound to the next plugin.

reduceNoise.description: Takes steady noise (a hum, a fan, hiss) out of a sound and hands the cleaned sound to the next plugin.
reduceNoise.title: Reduce noise

audio.description: The sound: a video or a stored file (an object with an absolute file path) or a path in text.

strength.description: How much of the noise is taken out, 0 to 1 (default 0.5). More also takes a little of the voice.

floorDb.description: The quietest a frequency is made, in dB (default -20), so the sound does not turn into bubbles.

audio.description: The cleaned sound, described as VideoCraw describes decoded sound (kind audio, f32le, file, sampleRate, channels, sampleCount, startMs...). Give it to an action that wants sound; it is good for this run only.

reducedDb.description: How much quieter the quietest tenth of the sound became, in dB.

failures.description: A param is wrong or audio is missing.
The file is not a sound this plugin can read.
VideoCraw gave the plugin no place to write the cleaned sound (it does not offer the outputs feature).
